description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for integrating Git with Perforce (p4), including setting up a Perforce server, adding files, and testing trigger configurations, clone and import operations, and submit procedures.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository environment after tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after a test completes.

methods.name: p4 triggers
methods.description: Configures or queries Perforce trigger settings.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones Perforce depot into Git repository.

methods.name: git p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes Perforce depot with Git repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether the specified path is a file.
